activities.activity_name: EC2 AMI Creation for Kafka Performance Tests

Design and implement a source module that generates synthetic load for performance testing, integrating with the existing XD framework, including unit tests and documentation.
Design and implement a sink module to receive data and measure throughput for performance testing, including integration with Kafka and reporting mechanisms.

activities.activity_name: Windows CI Build Setup and Test Isolation
activities.activity_description: Configure CI pipeline for Windows, set up build scripts, identify and isolate failing tests, experiment with AMI images, and document findings.

Design site structure, create content including samples, tutorials, links, benchmarks, and architectures, set up Jekyll deployment, and publish.
Continue proof of concept for Lattice/Diego integration, research scope and risks, design pluggable SPI for XD runtime, and prototype core components.
